name: ribbon-drift
title: Ribbon Drift
description: Scroll-driven ribbon gallery where image strips drift horizontally at alternating speeds, revealing project names with GSAP SplitText on scroll.

changelog.summary: Removed the reduced-motion animation branching entirely - the scroll-driven reveal, hover splits, and strip transitions now always run identically to the default; only the reduced-motion notice remains conditional.

Synced the docs-mirror RibbonDriftComp with the registry copy's full prefers-reduced-motion support (static layout, X-only strip exits, fade-based intro/hover transitions) - the mirror was missing all of it.
Restored the mobile full-height wrapper rule (max-md:h-full) that was lost to a max-snm typo; docs copy typo corrected to max-sm.
